description: Supplies UI role definitions to UiRoleVocabulary. Implement this interface to extend the built-in role vocabulary with product-specific concepts or synonyms.

members.name: SourceId
members.description: Unique identifier for this vocabulary source.

members.name: Priority
members.description: Higher priority wins when duplicate role slugs provide display metadata. Synonyms are always merged across sources.

members.name: GetRoles
members.description: Returns all UI role definitions supplied by this source.
